name: Construction & Natural Materials
summary: Introduces the high-volume materials of the built environment: cement and concrete, timber, stone, brick and asphalt.

topics.name: Portland cement: manufacture, clinker phases and hydration chemistry
Concrete: mix design, strength development, curing and durability
Reinforced and prestressed concrete from a materials viewpoint; rebar corrosion
Low-carbon cements, geopolymers and supplementary cementitious materials
Wood: cellular structure, anisotropy, moisture and engineered wood products
Glass in buildings: float glass, laminated and tempered glass
Durability, weathering and service life of construction materials
